flags.sentence: Because the treatment categories overlap, Kanta-Häme's crude curative treatment share of 23.4% (95% CI 20.1–27.2; n=128/546) versus 27.0% (4009/14873) nationally and crude life-prolonging treatment share of 32.2% (95% CI 28.4–36.3; n=176/546) versus 30.4% (4522/14873) nationally have 95% confidence intervals that include the national values.
flags.problem: Unsupported causal claim: the sentence states that the 95% confidence intervals include the national values 'Because the treatment categories overlap', whereas the overlap of treatment categories does not cause the confidence intervals to include the national values.

flags.sentence: Public data report crude county shares without age or stage adjustment, reflect recording practices for treatments and MDT meetings, and omit pathway waiting times.
flags.problem: Slight overstatement: according to fig:age_adjusted_only_kuva16, county-level age-adjusted treatment shares do appear in Kuva 16 (as a PNG figure by sex); only the county table (Taulukko 11) lacks age adjustment.
